title: B. Capability manifest
description: A read-only unit: what it computes, the Concept it implements, the persisted queries it reads through, and where it runs (`host`). It names no other Capability and nothing of the write side.

description.description: Read by the composer to pick Micro-UIs and by humans to find the unit.

ports.description: The ports of `ports.json` (contract Q) it reaches the outside through, by id.

host.description: Where it runs: on the product's server (the default) or inside a host without one — a plugin, a static app — compiled to WebAssembly and loaded by the host. A hostless Capability is never registered: `scripts/register.sh` and the registry's build script leave it out, and no server answers it.

output.description: A Concept reference (`Risk@3 & { asOf: DataVersion }`) or a shape.

reads.description: Paths of the persisted queries this Capability reads through — its only access to the Data.
